comment: All candidates shared Adam and nominal displacement 0.0512. K1017 supported larger feedforward width at equal depth, favoring D over E and A over C; K1069 supplied the weaker two-head preference favoring A over B. Depth was explicitly uncertain under K1017 in this regime. The gold places the three-layer, FF128 candidates between the two-layer FF256 and FF128 candidates, suggesting a modest depth benefit here, but one instance does not establish a general depth ordering.
